tickets.title: Coordinate Missing Signature Follow-Up
tickets.text: Use this coordination workflow when paperwork cannot be submitted or processed because a signature, initials, date, or required authorization is missing. Confirm the needed correction before contacting the client and keep the request limited to the deficient item. The Velvet Acorn Custody bank authorization package for Selena Thimblefern's 529 distributions showed her printed name and Teacup Comet Bank information but lacked the required authorization signature page.

subTasks.title: Validate the missing signature requirement
subTasks.text: Review the form package and processing notes to identify the exact missing signature, initials, date, or authorization. Confirm whether wet signature, e-signature, or custodian-specific language is required. The Velvet Acorn Custody bank authorization package for Selena Thimblefern's 529 distributions showed her printed name and Teacup Comet Bank information but lacked the required authorization signature page.

subTasks.title: Confirm planning or account impact
subTasks.text: Determine whether the missing signature affects account opening, transfer timing, trading authority, beneficiary changes, or other planning deadlines. Note any client-facing implications for the advisor.

subTasks.title: Send corrected signature request
subTasks.text: Contact the client through the approved secure channel with clear instructions, the corrected form or signature page, and a brief explanation of what is needed. Avoid sending unnecessary pages containing sensitive information. Request the missing authorization signature page for Selena Thimblefern's Velvet Acorn Custody 529 bank authorization package.

subTasks.title: Advisor confirmation before resubmission
subTasks.text: Review the completed correction and confirm the package is ready for resubmission or escalation if the client has questions about the request.

tickets.evidence: The committed follow-up is to correct the authorization package by 2026-05-09.
